protocol: Complete coordinator paired-rpc-v2 full suite, six pairs and one warmup, all 190 rows. No direct repeat endpoint: historical draft can change runner placement.
order: Finish all current candidate tasks and three cost audits plus all baseline extra tasks before deploying calibration. Then finish deployment/probe before three complete baseline calibration runs.
decision: Keep original public-vs-private and same-private-topology comparisons side by side, without pooling.
